item.title: New Franklin boys and girls double up Slater in CAC
item.description: The New Franklin boys’ and girls’ basketball teams picked up a sweep Tuesday night at home by beating the Slater Wildcats 68-41 and 60-26, respectively.

item.title: Pirates lasso Pintos in conference showdown
item.description: In a game they desperately needed to stay in the race in the Tri-County Conference, the Boonville Pirates basketball team circled the wagon Thursday night in a home game against the California Pintos.

item.title: Missouri weekly gas price update
item.description: Average gasoline prices in Missouri have risen 1 cent per gallon in the last week, averaging $2.51/g today, according to GasBuddy’s survey of 3,940 stations in Missouri. Prices in Missouri are 8.1 cents per gallon higher than a month ago and stand 34.8 cents per gallon lower than a year ago. The national average price of diesel has increased 2.9 cents compared to a week ago and stands at $3.614 per gallon.

item.title: Celebrate Fat Tuesday with traditional jazz
item.description: Come celebrate the sounds of New Orleans Mardi Gras on Tuesday, February 17 in Thespian Hall at 7:00 pm. Join the Fourteen Degrees Jazz Band as they play the classic tunes of Bourbon Street, such as “Saints Go Marching,” “Closer Walk,” “Up a Lazy River,” and “Muskrat Ramble.”

item.title: Cooper County Public Health Center expands school prevention programs to reduce youth tobacco, vaping, and substance use
item.description: The Cooper County Public Health Center (CCPHC) is expanding youth prevention education resources in response to findings from the Community Needs Assessment, which identified tobacco use, vaping, and substance misuse as priority concerns among youth. To address these growing public health risks, CCPHC has expanded evidence-based prevention programs aimed at preventing youth from using tobacco, vaping products, and other substances.

item.title: Critical Incident Family Support Team takes shape in county
item.description: A community initiative, the Critical Incident Family Support Team (CIFST), is continuing to take shape to provide compassionate support to families and loved ones affected by critical incidents involving first responders, schools, or major community emergencies.
